descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在开罗尝过库沙里后写的菜单。食材清单只写了一半，因为那时先拿起了勺子。
descriptions.en: A menu after koshari in Cairo. The inventory pauses where I picked up my spoon.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在开罗吃过ful medames后留下的两行小记：一行菜名，一行记自己放下勺子的轻响。
descriptions.en: Two lines after ful medames in Cairo: one for its name, one for the sound of my spoon coming to rest.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 从开罗埃及博物馆出来后写的便签，记着自己在一件首饰前停了两回。
descriptions.en: My own note after two pauses beside a piece of jewellery at Cairo’s Egyptian Museum.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在开罗爱资哈尔公园等人，我先走了一小段，碰头后两人把这段路接着走完。
descriptions.en: A note from Al-Azhar Park in Cairo: a short walk while waiting became a longer walk with company.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在开罗尝过库沙里和炖豆，我给自己的两张菜单各写了一个“今天”，从哪张都能开口讲。
descriptions.en: After koshari and ful medames in Cairo, both my menu backs began with “Today…” Either could start a story.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把在开罗埃及博物馆看首饰时的两次停步折在卡片两面，只带走自己的观察记忆。
descriptions.en: My two pauses before jewellery at Cairo’s Egyptian Museum, folded onto opposite sides of a homemade card.
